lines.text: HOA homes sell for about 4% more. Worth it?
lines.say: Homes in an HOA sell for about four percent more. Worth it?

lines.text: A 2019 study found at least 4%, about $13,500, over similar homes outside HOAs.
lines.say: A twenty nineteen study found at least four percent, about thirteen thousand five hundred dollars, over similar homes outside one.

lines.text: And HOAs grew from 2.1 million residents in 1970 to 74.1 million in 2020.
lines.say: And HOAs grew from about two million residents in nineteen seventy to about seventy-four million in twenty twenty.

lines.text: In 2024, 1 in 4 owners paid a condo or HOA fee. The median: $135 a month.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-four, one in four owners paid a condo or HOA fee, with a median of a hundred thirty-five dollars a month.

lines.text: You get shared perks, kept-up common areas and rules that protect the look. You also get fees that can rise, rules, fines and surprise assessments.
lines.say: You get shared perks, kept-up common areas and rules that protect the look. You also get fees that can rise, rules, fines and surprise assessments.

lines.text: Our math: a $300 monthly fee for 10 years is $36,000.
lines.say: Our math: a three hundred dollar monthly fee for ten years is thirty-six thousand dollars.

lines.text: Lenders count HOA dues in your debt-to-income ratio, so that $300 shrinks what you can borrow.
lines.say: And lenders count HOA dues in your debt-to-income ratio, so that three hundred dollars shrinks what you can borrow.

lines.text: The surprise: in most states, an HOA can foreclose over unpaid dues. Rules vary by state.
lines.say: The surprise: in most states, an HOA can foreclose over unpaid dues. Rules vary by state.

lines.text: Either way, compare the fee history, rules, reserves and past assessments before you pick a side.
lines.say: Either way, compare the fee history, the rules, the reserves and past assessments before you pick a side.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: HOA homes sell for about 4% more. Is the fee worth it?
post.ig:
HOA homes sell for about 4% more. Is it worth the fee?
A 2019 study found HOA homes priced at least 4% (about $13,500) above similar homes outside one.
In 2024, about 1 in 4 US owners paid a condo or HOA fee; the median was $135 a month.
Our math: $300 a month for 10 years is $36,000, and lenders count dues in your debt-to-income ratio.
In most states an HOA can foreclose over unpaid dues. Rules vary by state.
Sources: Journal of Urban Economics (2019), US Census Bureau ACS 2024, Foundation for Community Association Research.
